# Week Diabetes

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A weekly note or artifact aggregating diabetes-related tracking data for the week.

## Scope note

Parent concept for WeekDiabetesAnalysis; part of the health-tracking dimension of WeekCluster, alongside the broader WeekHealth.
